queries_run: CVNA Carvana Co. DOJ OR FTC OR antitrust OR regulatory investigation 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 法律程序章節：2025年6月收到SEC傳票，主要涉及做空機構報告的指控，公司表示全面配合；未提及反壟斷調查或拆分。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 3 Legal Proceedings
findings.excerpt: In June 2025, we received a subpoena from the SEC requesting information that we believe primarily relates to the allegations raised by the report. We are fully cooperating with the SEC Staff.

findings.claim: 10-K 列明受CFPB、FTC、DOT、DOJ、SEC等聯邦及各州經銷商監管機關管轄，屬一般產業監管，未列特定新規。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1 Government Regulation
findings.excerpt: the advertising, sale, purchase, financing, and transport of motor vehicles are highly regulated by states in which we do business and by the U.S. federal government.

findings.claim: 2026年搜尋未見DOJ/FTC/反壟斷對Carvana的調查報導；結果均為2026-01-28 Gotham City做空報告後原告律所的證券詐欺調查公告（非主管機關行動）。
findings.source: WebSearch 結果摘要（BFA Law、Kirby McInerney等新聞稿）

regulatory_antitrust.note: 未找到反壟斷/拆分相關來源；僅SEC傳票與律所證券調查。
